entries.Abigail_spouse: You'll have to tell me what's beyond, I can't go on... spiders...$s
entries.Abigail_spouse_y2: Have you ever fought any of these monsters before?$0#$e#Even... the s-spiders?$2
entries.Abigail_y2: Did you see the decorations on our house? I don't like it...$2
entries.Alex: There's something weird over there. But how do I get to it?#$e#There's gotta be a secret passage somewhere around here.
entries.Alex_spouse_y2: Hey, you made it past the creepy hands.$1#$e#I think I hear someone calling for help nearby.$0
entries.Alex_y2: I think I heard a girl screaming... She needs my help!$0
entries.Caroline: I get scared very easily. I'll leave the haunted maze to the younger people.
entries.Caroline_y2: I should make a plate of food for my husband. He's been manning the shop all night.$0
entries.Clint: One of my iridium-infused maces would make quick work of these things.
entries.Clint_y2: I already made it through the maze... now it's time to kick back with a pumpkin ale!#$e#...I'm trying my best to ignore the spider infestation behind me.$0
entries.Demetrius: I haven't seen Maru in hours... I hope she's alright.
entries.Demetrius_y2: Did you know... a study in the Journal of Anthropological Physiology found that the cadence, tempo, and key of music can have a measurable impact on cortisol levels?#$e#Er... Is there vanilla ice cream to go with the blackberry cobbler?$0
entries.Dwarf: You say it's raining up above? *gasp*#$e#Rain... It's almost mythical to us. Some of us live our entire lives without ever experiencing it.
entries.Elliott: Why, hello @. It's chilly, isn't it?
entries.Elliott_spouse: Mmph... I believe I've eaten a few too many slices of pumpkin pie.
entries.Elliott_spouse_y2: I shudder to think what would happen if these got loose...%noturn$2#$e#Fear not, my dear! I would run the cursed wretch through, before it could lay a finger on you.
entries.Elliott_y2: Oh pitiful wretch... in what fetid grotto lies your kingdom?%noturn$0#$e#Sometimes, one must stare into the abyss to stir a languid muse...
entries.Emily: Do you like the jack-o-lanterns? I carved them myself.
entries.Emily_spouse_y2: *giggle* I knew you'd find your way here.$0
entries.Emily_y2: Ooooh. You found the secret entrance too!$1
entries.Evelyn: I wish Gus would include a vegetarian option. Some zucchini skewers, maybe?
entries.Evelyn_y2: Dear, can you pass the zucchini fritters please?$0
entries.George: Hmm... smoked turkey haunch? I guess this festival isn't all bad.$h
entries.George_y2: If I wasn't in this blasted chair, I'd be running circles around everyone in that maze!$0
entries.Gus: It's a lot of fun to cook with pumpkin. Such an interesting fruit.
entries.Gus_y2: Carving pumpkins is a talent of mine. I usually do most of the Jack-O-Lanterns for everyone in town.#$b#All I ask in return is to keep the seeds... sprinkle a little cinnamon sugar on those puppies and you've got yourself a golden snack!$h
entries.Haley_spouse: I get scared easily... I think I'm just going to stay right here.$s
entries.Haley_spouse_y2: Hah! None of this is real.$h#$b#.... right, @? It's not real... right?$12
entries.Haley_y2: Have you seen my sister?$2#$e#Emily! Can you hear me?$2
entries.Harvey: Oh! You found me...$8#$b#The truth is, I got too scared so I came here to hide. Don't tell anyone.$s
entries.Harvey_spouse: Hi... I was hoping you'd find me here...$l
entries.Harvey_spouse_y2: I was wondering when I'd see you.$1#$e#Don't mind me. I'm just taking a quick breather.$0
entries.Harvey_y2: I'm afraid to say I'm quite puzzled on this one...$0
entries.Jas: But Aunt Marnie! I wanna go in the maze! I'm not scared!$s
entries.Jodi: Vincent's upset that I won't let him go into the haunted maze... but he's just a little boy!
entries.Jodi_y2: Sam took Vincent into the maze. I hope they're okay...$0
entries.Kent_y2: These things don't look so tough.$0
entries.Leah: Mm, hi. Sorry... mouth full of blackberries.
entries.Leah_spouse: I may have had a little too much pumpkin ale...
entries.Leah_spouse_y2: I probably had too much pumpkin ale before jumping into the maze.$2#$e#You go on ahead. I'll catch up.$0
entries.Leah_y2: Is it this way? Or maybe over here?$0
entries.Leo: %Leo's unblinking eyes are glued to the screen. You're unable to get his attention.
entries.Leo_y2: This is a maze inside of a maze... My head is spinning...$0
entries.Lewis: Good evening, @. Have you ventured into the haunted maze yet? It's quite spooky.#$e#That strange man who lives in the tower set it all up himself. He wouldn't let anyone near while he was working on it.
entries.Lewis_y2: Good evening, @. Once again, we've been graced with a haunted maze, constructed in secret by the eccentric who lives out in the forest.$0#$e#I've heard it's larger this year. Good luck if you dare to venture inside...
entries.Linus_y2: Haha! Another fine creation, my old friend.$1
entries.Marlon: Don't get too close to the cage.
entries.Marlon_y2: I caught more monsters this year. Mind your distance near the cages.
entries.Marnie: Hi, @. Have you had a productive fall?#$e#It's starting to get quite cold... crops won't hold out for much longer.
entries.Marnie_y2: I hope Jas is okay in there.$2#$e#Did you have a successful year farming, @?
entries.Maru: I think I've already been this way... no, wait...$s#$e#I'm lost...$s
entries.Maru_spouse: I'm confused... you go on ahead and let me figure this out.
entries.Maru_spouse_y2: Grab a plate and sit down with the family!$1
entries.Maru_y2: After I finish this food, I'm going head-first into that maze!$0
entries.Pam: I'll come to any event with free grub! You won't see me in the haunted maze, though.
entries.Pam_y2: Pass another bottle of pumpkin ale over here!... *hic*$1
entries.Penny: The vapor from this cauldron... it's making my head spin, but I can't seem to leave...$u
entries.Penny_spouse: Oh... These vapors... Hmmm... You look nice tonight.$l
entries.Penny_spouse_y2: *phew* I got lost in the maze...$3#$e#I was worried I might get trapped and everyone would go home without me!$12
entries.Penny_y2: I was in the maze for a while but then I got hungry.$0#$e#My Mom seems to be enjoying herself.$0
entries.Pierre_y2: Ah, it's farmer @! I have quite the selection of wares tonight. Take a look!$0
entries.Robin: Well, winter's almost here. It's a great time to stockpile wood and stone.
entries.Robin_y2: Are you looking forward to things slowing down soon? Winter is around the corner.$0
entries.Sam: That's odd... It's just a dead end up ahead.#$e#I could've sworn there was someone ahead of me when I went through the maze, though. Where'd they go?
entries.Sam_spouse: Hey, I was wondering when you'd show up!$h
entries.Sam_spouse_y2: My little brother and I made it pretty far in here but we got stuck.#$e#You go on ahead... find that treasure for us!
entries.Sam_y2: Am I Sam? Heh, heh, heh...$11
entries.Sandy: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
entries.Sandy_y2: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
entries.Sebastian: I have no idea how these skeletons are walking... creepy.#$e#It's pretty cool though.
entries.Sebastian_spouse: It would be interesting to have one of these on the farm.
entries.Sebastian_spouse_y2: Hey, could you... give me a hand? Hehehe...$h#$e#These gravestones would look nice on the farm, don't you think?$0
entries.Shane: Why is there no more pumpkin ale?
entries.Shane_spouse_y2: I talked Marnie into letting me take Jas into the maze. I think she's old enough.$0#$e#We're going very slow, though. Go ahead without us!$1
entries.Shane_y2: You gotta stay close to me, Jas. Don't run off!%noturn$0
entries.Vincent: Mother won't let me go in the maze. *sob*$s
entries.Vincent_y2: Did we beat the maze? Where's my prize?$0
entries.Willy_y2: I'd watch yer back, lad... something terrible's in that maze...^I'd watch yer back, miss... something terrible's in that maze...
entries.Wizard: The affairs of mundane folk matter little to me, but the elementals like a chance to see you up close.#$e#It was for them that I created this silly maze.
entries.Wizard_y2: The trials continue... Every magician must have an apprentice...
